column1: # Pillar 2 empirical Iso-G sizing (vs theoretical iid iso-G).
# Bins: 10 even-width bins over p in [0, 1]. mean_delta_div from
# zvf_contrastive_yield.tsv for that bin. G_empirical = smallest G
# delta_G > 0 means the empirical sampler NEEDS MORE rollouts than
# the iid theory assumes (herding regime); delta_G < 0 means
# FEWER (anti-herding regime). This is the directly testable
# prediction the Contrastive Yield framing licenses.
